votd.text: Let nothing be done through strife or vainglory; but in lowliness of mind let each esteem other better than themselves. Look not every man on his own things, but every man also on the things of others.
votd.content: Let nothing be done through strife or vainglory; but in lowliness of mind let each esteem other better than themselves. <sup class="versenum">4 </sup>Look not every man on his own things, but every man also on the things of others.
